ValidationRule.description: Checks whether Days of demurrage is blank or not
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c),NOT(CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'Digital Hub' )), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c , 'Demurrage'), AND(OR(ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closed'),ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closure Pending')), ISBLANK( PMC_SS_DaysOfDemurrage_c__c )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Days of demurrage cannot be empty
